lines: Not run - needs admin on the DCs (reader mode): dcdiag, repadmin (the replication queue, backups), the DC services, SYSVOL and DFSR, the disks, the event logs, w32tm and the Security log (who made a change).
sections.text: Reader mode (ad_health_mode: reader): read from the AAP side over LDAP (simple bind over LDAPS), DNS and Kerberos as svc_aap_adreader@CORP.EXAMPLE.MIL - a plain domain user, nothing granted - from DC01. Nothing is run on a DC and nothing is written to AD.
sections.title: How this was read

sections.text: The domain: functional levels, schema version, its DCs (answering / in AD), the PDC emulator, the tombstone lifetime, the Recycle Bin, how much of the RID pool is left and the age of the krbtgt password.
sections.title: Domain

sections.text: Each DC AD lists, and each the inventory has: its site, OS, global catalog / read-only, the operations master roles it holds, whether it is in the inventory and in AD.
sections.title: Domain controllers

sections.text: Each DC from here: LDAP 389 answering, LDAPS 636 answering and the bind as svc_aap_adreader@CORP.EXAMPLE.MIL, isSynchronized, its clock against the other DCs' (rootDSE currentTime; amber 120 s, red 300 s), its KDC (a ticket (TGT) from it with kinit, or an AS-REQ it must answer) and its LDAPS certificate's days left.
sections.title: Domain controllers answering

sections.text: Who holds each role (fSMORoleOwner), whether that holder is still a DC, and whether it answers on LDAP from here.
sections.title: Operations masters (FSMO roles)

sections.text: Each DC's inbound replication from each partner, for every partition, as far as svc_aap_adreader@CORP.EXAMPLE.MIL may read it (here: repsFrom - on each DC's own copy of the partition head; no repadmin). Only links with a problem are listed: amber after 6 h without success or a failing link that succeeded recently, red after 24 h or longer than the tombstone lifetime. 2 link(s) are healthy. No link has a problem.
sections.title: Inbound replication

sections.text: The SRV records clients use to find a DC - every DC (every GC for _gc) must be registered - and each DC's A record (against the inventory's address, when the inventory gives one).
sections.title: DNS

sections.text: Each DC's LDAPS certificate, read from the TLS handshake on port 636: amber 30 days, red 7 days before it expires, amber when this side does not trust it (ad_reader_validate_certs).
sections.title: Certificates (LDAPS)

sections.text: Members added to or removed from the privileged groups, when and on which DC, from AD's replication metadata (msDS-ReplValueMetaData). Who made a change is only in the DCs' Security logs, which reader mode cannot read. No change.
